summary: Per-vehicle wheel-contact proximity check on the frame path. Computes the squared position delta between the current history slots (this+15020/15024/15028) and the recorded position triplet (this+13524/13528/13532), returns 0 in the dead-zone when movement is near zero, then rolls the recorded position into the history slots. When the rotation alignment dot product at this+13504 is high (>= 0.94999999) it runs the full proximity test through PositionChangeMonitor, projecting the recorded offset onto the monitor basis and testing extents at offsets 88 and 92 against the threshold at this+15212; otherwise a low-alignment path scans up to 4 active contact entries at this+2088 (stride 296) before the same test. Returns 1 when no condition disqualifies.

operations.description: v2 = this + 13524: pointer to the recorded position triplet (byte offset 0x34D4).
Per-axis position delta between the current history slots (this+15020, this+15024, this+15028 = offsets 0x3AAC/0x3AB0/0x3AB4) and the recorded triplet (offsets 0x34D4/0x34D8/0x34DC).
v6 = v4*v4 + v3*v3 + v5*v5: squared magnitude of the position delta.
Early-out band: when v6 < 0.0009 (dbl_5AD1C8) the movement is near zero.
If the dead-zone enable flag at this+12988 (offset 0x32BC) is set, the position is pinned: return 0.
return 0 (pinned / dead-zone suppressed).
If movement is still below 0.000009 (dbl_5AD1D0) even with the flag clear, treat as static: return 0.
return 0 (essentially static).
Snapshot recorded Y/Z values: v8 = *(this+13528), v9 = *(this+13532) (offsets 0x34D8/0x34DC).
Roll the recorded position into history: *(this+15020) = *(v2); *(this+15024) = v8; *(this+15028) = v9 (offsets 0x3AAC/0x3AB0/0x3AB4 updated).
Alignment branch on the rotation dot product at this+13504 (offset 0x34C0): if it is >= 0.94999999 (flt_59EE8C) run the full monitor proximity test; otherwise take the low-alignment path.
PositionChangeMonitor(this) returns the monitor record v12; read the two neighbor records v13 = *(v12+272) and v14 = *(v12+268).
Project the relative offset of the recorded position against the monitor basis: v27 = *(v2)-*(v12), v28 = *(v2+4)-*(v12+4), v26 = (*(v2+8)-*(v12+8))*(v12+40) + v28*(v12+36) + v27*(v12+32).

Positive-side contact: when v26 < threshold at this+15212 (offset 0x3B6C), compare the extent field at offset 88 across the monitor/neighbors; return 1 if (threshold - v26) exceeds the minimum extent.
return 1 (positive-side overlap detected).
Negative-side contact: when -(threshold at this+15212) < v26, compare the extent field at offset 92; return 1 if (v26 + threshold) exceeds the minimum extent.
return 1 (negative-side overlap detected).
Return 1 when the first compare-flag pair (v21|v22) is set.
return 1 (first flag pair set).
Return 0 when the second compare-flag pair (v24|v25) is clear.
return 0 (second flag pair clear).

Low-alignment path: scan the contact array from this+2088 (offset 0x828) in stride 296 while an entry is present and its active byte at +64 (offset 0x868) is set; stop after 4 entries and fall through to the monitor test.
Very low alignment: when the rotation dot product at this+13504 (offset 0x34C0) is below 0.70710677 (flt_5AD1C4), return 1 immediately without the monitor test.
return 1 (alignment too low).
return 1 fallback when no early-return condition triggered.
